mapper.select:
SELECT pcv.violation_id violationId, pd.`name` driverName, uo.org_name department, td.`name` position, pc.license, pc.brand, pc.model, pc.seat_num seatNum, pcv.date violationTime, pcv.address, pcv.deduction, pcv.fine, pcv.content,pcv.driver_id driverId FROM pubcar_car_violation pcv LEFT JOIN pubcar_car pc ON pc.car_id = pcv.car_id AND pc.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN pubcar_driver pd ON pd.driver_id = pcv.driver_id AND pd.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN u_org uo ON uo.org_id = pd.department_id AND uo.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN t_dict td ON td.status_cd = pd.position_id AND td.table_name = 'u_org_staff_rel' AND td.table_columns = 'rel_cd' WHERE pcv.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND pcv.community_id = #{communityId} AND pcv.handle_status = #{handleStatus} ORDER BY pcv.create_time DESC
limit #{page}, #{row}
mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_car_violation(b_id, violation_id, `date`, address, driver, content, deduction, fine, car_id, driver_id, handle_status, operate, community_id) values (#{bId}, #{violationId}, #{date}, #{address}, #{driver}, #{content}, #{deduction}, #{fine}, #{carId}, #{driverId}, #{handleStatus}, #{operate}, #{communityId})
